Joy Raboli, Principal

Mom, Curriculum Lover, Swiftie and Oregon Duck Fan
Joy has been teaching since she was five years old—just ask the neighborhood kids she rounded up to play “school” in the backyard. By 18, she was already spending summers with gifted education trainers, helping teachers expand their skills. Teaching wasn’t just a dream for Joy—it was her calling.

Her first official classroom was in Redmond, Washington, where she taught 6th grade and discovered that what had once been a childhood game had turned into the most fulfilling career imaginable. Soon after, she was selected to work with Susan Kovalik and Associates, becoming a curriculum expert in the biology of learning. Joy went on the road, training more than 9,000 teachers in 30 states, keynoting national conferences, creating award-winning teacher training films, and even working as far afield as South Carolina, Nantucket, and New Zealand.

As much as she loved life on the road, Joy missed the heartbeat of a real classroom. She returned to Oregon schools, poured her energy into her students, and became mom to two amazing daughters—her proudest role of all. Along the way, she earned her administrative credential at the University of Oregon and created H.E.A.R.T. Skills, a school-wide character development program and book that continues to inspire teachers and students alike.

Now beginning her 14th year as principal of Sherwood Charter School—and celebrating more than 30 years in education—Joy still carries the same spark she had at age five. Her mission is simple but powerful: to create schools where every child is seen as gifted, curiosity is celebrated, and learning is deeply meaningful.

She continues to live and lead by her seven guiding principles, which serve as her north star in creating outstanding learning environments where both staff and students thrive. Read Ms. Raboli’s seven guiding principles used at SCS to create an outstanding learning environment.

Email: jraboli@sherwoodcharterschool.org

Email

Our Teachers

Heather Kerbo, Kindergarten

Teacher, self made chef, Gardner and mother of three
I am excited to begin my fourth year teaching kindergarten here at Sherwood Charter School! This marks my 11th year in education, and I’ve had the pleasure of working with students from Pre-K through 2nd grade across the Portland metro area. However, I have truly found my passion working with kindergarten students! I hold a Master’s degree in Curriculum & Instruction from Portland State University. I’m married and have three wonderful children who are now 6.5, 9.5, and 20 years old, along with our beloved dog, Blue, who is basically another child in the family. We’ve recently added three chickens to our little crew, and they’ve brought even more fun and chaos to our home! Two of my children are currently enrolled here at Sherwood Charter School, now in first and fourth grade. As a family, we love camping, traveling to new places, creating art, and enjoying playdates with friends. We lead a busy life, but we always prioritize quality time together. I’m thrilled to continue sharing my love of learning and helping your children grow this school year!

 

Email: hkerbo@sherwoodcharterschool.org

Samantha Coats, 1st Grade

First Grade Teacher, Artist, Dancer, Lifelong Learner
I come to SCS with experience in teaching Kindergarten, as well as working with K-5 students in afterschool care for many years. My Master’s degree in Elementary Education comes from Portland State University, where I had the privilege to focus on arts integration for the classroom. I love all forms of art, and bring that love with me into my classroom to give students enriching and meaningful learning experiences. A couple of my favorite forms of art to do in my free time include woven loom tapestries, and aerial dance. In my classroom students will have the opportunity to discover new things, master academic skills, and build lasting friendships. My goal is to teach students to love lifelong learning, just as I do. I look forward to a fun year of learning with you in first grade!

Email: scoats@sherwoodcharterschool.org

1st Grade Class Website

Hannah Atwood, 2nd Grade

Cat mom, traveler, children’s book enthusiast
I am so excited for another year at SCS teaching my favorite grade! I came to SCS with a bachelor’s degree from George Fox in Elementary Education with endorsements in Language Arts and ESOL. In my classroom, your student will grow as a friend, problem-solver, author, mathematician, artist, and lifelong learner! When I’m not teaching, I love going on walks, reading, and snuggling my two fluffy cats. I can’t wait for another awesome year in Second Grade!

Email: hatwood@sherwoodcharterschool.org

Class Website

2nd Grade Class Website

Jessica Wylie, 3rd Grade

Teacher, explorer, lover of the arts, toddler mom
I am passionate about creativity and innovation. I strive to make learning an immersive experience for students; one where they can role-play, make connections to the real world, build things, and bring learning to life in meaningful ways. In my personal life, you can find me playing with my toddler, doing puzzles & art projects, or exploring new places with my family. I am grateful to be a part of the SCS community, and am excited to see the magic unfold once again at this unique school.

Email: jwylie@sherwoodcharterschool.org

Class Website

Lindsey Manlove, 4th Grade

Big on books, bigger on belonging… and someday, pickleball greatness
I’m Lindsey Manlove, and I’m so excited to be teaching 4th grade at Sherwood Charter School this year. I was drawn to SCS because of its close-knit community, creative approach to teaching, and the way it truly puts kids first. This is my 14th year in education, including three years as a teacher-librarian—so if you ever need a great book recommendation, I’m your person. I love creating a class family where kids feel safe, seen, and excited to learn, and I’m passionate about helping them grow into kind, thoughtful humans. I live in Sherwood with my husband, Dave, our two kids, Charley and Dean, and a small zoo of pets. We love traveling (especially to Sunriver), relaxing with our neighborhood friends, watching movies, and reading lots of books together. I can already tell this is going to be a special year, and I feel lucky to be part of the SCS family.

Email: lmanlove@sherwoodcharterschool.org

Danielle Sollman, 5th Grade

Teacher, Toddler Mom, Avid Reader, and Frequent Coffee Reheater
I’m a dedicated educator with a passion for making learning engaging, interactive, and fun. This is my 11th year teaching 5th grade, and my second year at SCS—I’m thrilled to continue growing within such a supportive and welcoming school community. My goals for the year include creating a warm, inclusive classroom environment and helping students build a strong growth mindset. Outside the classroom, I’m a busy toddler mom who loves cooking, getting lost in a good thriller novel, and enjoying movie nights with my family. I’m looking forward to connecting with new families and making this school year a meaningful and memorable one for all of us!

Email: dsollman@sherwoodcharterschool.org

5th Grade Class Website

David Lamb, Physical Education and Health

Father, Woodworker, Soccer Fan
I am thrilled to continue my journey with the SCS community, bringing with me a diverse background that includes years of experience as an instructor in the U.S. Air Force and as a foreman in an electric motor shop. As a licensed professional soccer coach and referee with 17 years of coaching experience, I am passionate about creating a supportive, energetic environment where students can grow both on and off the field. I’ve had the privilege of working with K–12 athletes, helping them develop not only their athletic skills but also their character, teamwork, and confidence as young adults. I’m excited to begin another dynamic year in Physical Education and look forward to playing a meaningful role in each student’s educational journey. Outside of school, you’ll often find me in my woodshop or on the soccer pitch—coaching, officiating, or cheering on the Portland Thorns, Timbers, and Tottenham Hotspur.

Email: dlamb@sherwoodcharterschool.org

Class website

Email
PE Class Website

Amanda DuPriest, Music

Music teacher, choir geek, band nerd, and Star Wars fanatic
My passion as a musician stems from my near-constant involvement in choirs and wind ensembles since childhood, and I have dreamed of becoming a music teacher since high school. It is my goal to provide a safe, nurturing, healthy, and inspirational environment where children can grow as young musicians, and I love inspiring my students to learn more about classical music by tying it to the music they currently have in their lives, whether that is a film score, a song on the radio, or song loops from their favorite video game. When I’m not at SCS, you can find me directing my local pep and marching band, beating on drums with my fellow percussionists, playing D&D or video games with my friends, cross-stitching with my sister, or catching up on our favorite TV shows with my wife, Jen, and our three cats, Cat Benatar, Ebony, and Stevie “Nikki” Nicks.

Email: adupriest@sherwoodcharterschool.org

Class Website

Email
Music Class Website

Sara Knee, Art

Artist, Educator and Mom
My passion for both education and art started at a young age and by the time I was graduating high school, I knew I wanted to be an art teacher. This will be my 11th year as an educator and 7th year as SCS’ art teacher and Mountain Lion house leader. I am grateful to be able to share my love for the arts with the creative community of SCS. It’s hard to pick my favorite medium – I especially enjoy watercolors, ceramics, crochet and embroidery – when I can find the time. As a teacher, my favorite thing is seeing my students gain confidence in their own creativity and show pride in what they make. When I’m not at school you might find me rocking out to live music with my sketchbook in hand or spending quality time with my two daughters and our cuddly dog and spunky cat.

Email: sknee@sherwoodcharterschool.org

Class Website

Email
Art Class Website

Faith Barchers, Science

My passion for science began as a program lead at Outdoor School in Portland, and I am excited to bring the same principles of hands-on, inquiry led science to the classroom. I have a Masters in Teaching from OSU, and a Bachelors in archaeology. In my personal life, I enjoy playing tabletop games, traveling, crafting, reading, and spending time outdoors. I am excited to help the middle schoolers learn about our incredible natural world and advancing technology, as well as develop their engineering and problem solving skills.

Email: fbarchers@sherwoodcharterschool.org

Class Website

Email
Science Class Website

Hunter Bartoo, Math

Teacher, Swim Coach, Inclusive Adventurer, Amateur Sewer
I am so excited to begin my journey at SCS as a middle math teacher! I have a bachelors of science in Elementary education as well as an endorsement in Middle School Science and Math. I started my teaching career as a Middle School Science teacher where I found my passion and love for project based learning. My second year I was a full time sub and ended the year as a 5th grade humanities teacher. When I’m not teaching you’ll catch me on the pool deck coaching high school swimming. When I’m not coaching I love to cook, sew, and take on any new building projects. I am excited to have found a place at SCS and am grateful to have the opportunity to foster a new culture of learning.

Email: hbartoo@sherwoodcharterschool.org

Class Website Coming Soon

Email
Math Class Website Coming Soon

Ellie Iliscupidez, Humanities

Loves nature, being enchanted by stories and podcasts, and Taylor Swift
I adore all things middle school! It is the threshold between childhood and young adulthood and full of possibilities. Several years teaching at the middle school level has proven to me that there is nowhere else I’d rather be. In Humanities, we will explore history and literacy in a way that empowers scholars to lean into their strengths and become the best version of themselves. We will have an added focus on being good people and creating individual and collective impacts in our community and beyond. At school–ELA, SEL, social studies, discussions and project-based learning are my passions (apart from students of course!). Outside of school you’ll most likely find me in my berks, with my family, enjoying all that Oregon has to offer!

Email: eiliscupidez@sherwoodcharterschool.org

Class Website

Email

Our Staff

Angela Havlinek, Office Manager

Mother, gardener, baker and fourth generation native Oregonian
Since beginning at Sherwood Charter School in 2014, I have enjoyed building positive relationships with the students and their families. I look forward to seeing the kids grow not only as young scholars, but also as individuals. It’s exciting to be a part of their journey. I love being a member of the SCS team and value the work that each staff member contributes each day. When I’m not in the office, you can find me with my family, outside in my yard, or baking!

Email: office@sherwoodcharterschool.org

Cheryl McLeod, Administrative Specialist

Traveler, amateur chef, and history enthusiast
I am thrilled to be working at SCS! Since joining the team in 2016, I have loved getting to see the students grow in confidence and knowledge, and seeing them move on to their next grade each year. My goal is to make our school a welcoming environment to both students and families! When I’m not working, I enjoy reading, being with my family, and trying out new recipes.

Email: office@sherwoodcharterschool.org

Denise Zinkel, Secretary

Mom of two, dog lover, history buff and football fan
I’m a proud mom of two, a dog lover, and a history and football fan (Go Ducks!). I feel so lucky to be part of Sherwood Charter School, where every day brings new smiles, stories, and surprises. Getting to know our students and families is one of the best parts of my job. When I’m not at school, you’ll probably find me walking with my dogs, Luna and Mina, listening to a good audiobook, or enjoying time with my family—whether we’re watching a football game, having a meal together, or relaxing outdoors.

Email: dzinkel@sherwoodcharterschool.org

Kaylie Ellis, School Counselor

Adventurer, Mom, Grandma, and Kiara’s human
I’m grateful to be part of such a caring community and to spend my days supporting students as they learn and grow. The heart of my work is making sure every student feels truly heard and respected, because when students know their voice matters, they can grow with confidence, kindness, and compassion for others. My goal is to create a safe and welcoming space where those connections can happen. Outside of school, you’ll often find me walking with my Great Dane, Kiara, playing with my grandsons, working in my yard, or off on a little adventure. I also enjoy photography, exploring family history, listening to audiobooks, and playing games with family and friends.

Email: kellis@sherwoodcharterschool.org

Kaela Merrill, Aide

Friend, Knowledge Seeker, Listener, Crafter, Mom
I am very happy to be joining the team here at SCS! Not only because my own kids will be there, but because I’m excited to encourage all of the students in their daily lives and watch them grow in their experiences! Education is so important to our kids’ wellbeing and I am overjoyed to help facilitate a happy and safe learning environment where they can be themselves and learn to thrive. I bring enthusiasm, patience, and a playful approach to keep the school day educational and enjoyable for all. Outside of school, I enjoy hanging out with my family, reading, crocheting fun things, dancing around, and joking with my kids.

Kaylee Dalebroux, Aide

As a dedicated parent and active volunteer at SCS, I am excited to expand my role within this wonderful school community as an aide. With my own child attending the school, I’ve had the opportunity to build strong relationships with students, teachers, and staff. I’m passionate about supporting every child’s learning journey. I bring a kind, patient, and nurturing approach to working with children, always aiming to create a positive and encouraging environment. When I’m not working, I enjoy the outdoors- swimming, paddle boarding, camping and hiking. You can also find me getting creative with some sort of project or listening to podcasts!

Email: kdalebroux@sherwoodcharterschool.org
